cond_0001.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
As a Supplier Quality Engineer - Sensors, You'll
Assess the capability of potential suppliers. Assess the manufacturability of new product designs and assist the engineering team/suppliers with improving and developing manufacturing processes. Review prototype and production part quality document submissions from suppliers, and provide feedback. Issue corrective action requests to suppliers and provide support with their resolution. Provide support to Manufacturing, Quality, and Vehicle Engineering regarding analysis and disposition of suspect supplier material. Drive continuous improvement throughout the supply base using quality and lean manufacturing tools.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4+ Years of experience in quality, supplier quality, or manufacturing in one of the following industries: Automotive, aviation, computer, or medical device
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field
Experience with sensor (lidar, camera, radar, etc.) development, test and manufacturing processes
Experience with the manufacture of complex electromechanical and optomechanical assemblies
Experience in manufacturing processes (e.g. PCB, PCBA, wire harnesses, stamping, and mechanical assembly)
Working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing
Experience using problem solving techniques (e.g. Six-Sigma, 8-Discipline, Pareto Charts, Regression Analysis, ANOVA, DOE, Fish Bone Analysis, Red-X, Is/Is Not)
Experience using quality analysis and control tools (e.g. Process Flow Diagrams, Process FMEAs, Process Control Plans, SPC, MSA, Process Capability)
Fully literate in Microsoft computer applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in Engineering or related field
Experience creating and improving quality systems
Working knowledge of quality systems (e.g. ISO 9000 and IATF 16949)
Certifications such as ASQ, Six Sigma Green Belt, or Six Sigma Black Belt

As a Supplier Quality Engineer - Sensors, you'll work across supplier assessment, product quality, and continuous improvement. Most people become stronger in this kind of work over time as they build experience with supplier processes and quality systems.
cond_0113.responsibilities: Assess the capability of potential suppliers. Assess the manufacturability of new product designs and assist the engineering team/suppliers with improving and developing manufacturing processes. Review prototype and production part quality document submissions from suppliers, and provide feedback. Issue corrective action requests to suppliers and provide support with their resolution. Provide support to Manufacturing, Quality, and Vehicle Engineering regarding analysis and disposition of suspect supplier material. Drive continuous improvement throughout the supply base using quality and lean manufacturing tools.
cond_0113.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field
4+ Years of experience in quality, supplier quality, or manufacturing in one of the following industries: Automotive, aviation, computer, or medical device
Experience with sensor (lidar, camera, radar, etc.) development, test and manufacturing processes
Experience with the manufacture of complex electromechanical and optomechanical assemblies
Experience in manufacturing processes (e.g. PCB, PCBA, wire harnesses, stamping, and mechanical assembly)
Working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing
Experience using problem solving techniques (e.g. Six-Sigma, 8-Discipline, Pareto Charts, Regression Analysis, ANOVA, DOE, Fish Bone Analysis, Red-X, Is/Is Not)
Experience using quality analysis and control tools (e.g. Process Flow Diagrams, Process FMEAs, Process Control Plans, SPC, MSA, Process Capability)
Fully literate in Microsoft computer applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in Engineering or related field
Experience creating and improving quality systems
Working knowledge of quality systems (e.g. ISO 9000 and IATF 16949)

cond_0219.intro: We are looking for a Supplier Quality Engineer - Sensors to join our team.
cond_0219.responsibilities:

Assess the capability of potential suppliers. Assess the manufacturability of new product designs and assist the engineering team/suppliers with improving and developing manufacturing processes. Review prototype and production part quality document submissions from suppliers, and provide feedback. Issue corrective action requests to suppliers and provide support with their resolution. Provide support to Manufacturing, Quality, and Vehicle Engineering regarding analysis and disposition of suspect supplier material. Drive continuous improvement throughout the supply base using quality and lean manufacturing tools.
cond_0219.requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Around 4 years of experience in quality, supplier quality, or manufacturing in one of the following industries: Automotive, aviation, computer, or medical device

Experience with the manufacture of complex electromechanical and optomechanical assemblies
Experience in manufacturing processes (e.g. PCB, PCBA, wire harnesses, stamping, and mechanical assembly)
Working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing
Familiarity with problem solving techniques (e.g. Six-Sigma, 8-Discipline, Pareto Charts, Regression Analysis, ANOVA, DOE, Fish Bone Analysis, Red-X, Is/Is Not)
Familiarity with quality analysis and control tools (e.g. Process Flow Diagrams, Process FMEAs, Process Control Plans, SPC, MSA, Process Capability)
Comfort with Microsoft applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

Master's degree in Engineering or related field
Background in creating and improving quality systems
Working knowledge of quality systems (e.g. ISO 9000 and IATF 16949)

Familiarity with problem solving techniques (e.g. Six-Sigma, 8-Discipline, Pareto Charts, Regression Analysis, ANOVA, DOE, Fish Bone Analysis, Red-X, Is/Is Not)
